---
title: "Complexity Evaluation"
---

Welcome, and thank you for taking part in this study conducted by **ESTIA** as part of a research project in decision engineering. 

This study focuses on multi-criteria decision-making problems, and more specifically on bi-objective cases, where a choice must be made between several options by considering two criteria simultaneously (e.g., cost and performance). 

Our goal is to better understand **how decision-makers perceive the complexity of these problems**. In other words, we aim to identify the factors that make a decision problem more or less complex, and to associate one or more measures of complexity with them. 

There are no right or wrong answers — we are interested in your personal perception. 

The questionnaire takes less than 10 minutes. 
Thank you for your participation!
